firm_data.firm_description: The United States Attorney's Office for the Eastern District of New York represents the United States in Brooklyn, Queens, Staten Island, and Long Island. Their mission is to seek justice under the law in protecting and serving the people of this district and nation.
notable_facts: The Eastern District of New York is one of the premier U.S. Attorney’s Offices in the nation.
The office has a very active and sophisticated national security program.
The office prosecutes virtually every type of federal crime and represents the interests of the United States in civil litigation.
